purpose: Replace low-resolution wizard frames with four independently authored detailed sheets; retain original art.

prompts.se: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a high-resolution replacement game animation sprite sheet from the attached existing Starveil Arcanist atlas. Output one 2048x2048 transparent RGBA image, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 512px cells, no grid lines, text or background. ONLY the front southeast-facing wizard from the FIRST TWO ROWS of the reference. Preserve his identity: silver-haired older clean-shaven wizard, midnight navy and teal robes, gold embroidery, long cloak, brown boots, tall staff with circular bronze cage and blue-white star. Crisp realistic painted game sprites, exquisitely sharp eyes, individual hair strands, defined fingers, metallic embroidery, no blurry brushwork. Enlarge and faithfully redraw the reference poses with real new detail, not blurry enlargement. Row 1 = the first four idle breathing poses from reference row1. Row2 = its next four walking poses. Row3 = first four casting poses from reference row2. Row4 = its four death poses from upright wounded to kneeling to lying down. Each cell contains exactly one complete figure/staff, clear empty margins, SAME body scale across cells, no overlapping cells, centered feet at x256,y470 in each standing cell, standing actor including staff about420 pixels tall. Maintain same southeast view throughout all16 frames, coherent facial identity and outfit across frames, subtle fluid differences during idle, clear stride during walk, same animated poses as reference. Real alpha transparency.
prompts.sw: Game-ready animation sheet, identity-preserve. Image1 is the new crisp detailed wizard appearance to match. Image2 is the original poses/directions reference. Create ONE sheet only for FRONT THREE QUARTER facing left/southwest, face visible. Use original reference image2 ROWS THREE AND FOUR for direction and poses. Staff appears at the opposite side to the first sheet. Exactly sixteen full body figures, 4 columns x 4 rows, each in an equally sized cell, generously separated by EMPTY margins at every row and column. Output high resolution 2048 square. Genuine alpha transparent background; if transparency cannot be supplied use pure flat white background, absolutely NO checkerboard, no gray pattern, no shadows on background. Row1 four subtle breathing idle poses. Row2 four different alternating foot stride walking poses. Row3 four casting poses: gather, raise staff, extend free hand and release, recover. Row4 four death poses: wounded upright, knee buckles, collapsing, fully lying on ground. Every complete staff, boot, hair and cloak remains within its cell. Same actor body scale and fixed foot ground line across standing poses. Never duplicate or mirror another sheet: independently draw this specified direction. Silver-haired older clean-shaven man, midnight-blue and teal layered robes, bronze-gold trims, leather belt pouches, brown boots, flowing cloak, tall staff with bronze circular astrolabe and white-blue star. Preserve identical costume and head design of image1, high fidelity polished realistic painted game sprite with sharp tiny facial/hair/fabric/metal details, distinct crisp edges, not blurry, not pixel art. No text or grid lines.
